title: Scaffold an app
note: Writes a go.mod, one starter action, a main.go wiring rastrillo.Run, and the rastrillo/ui design tokens — then runs generate once, so the next step just works.

title: Run it
cmd: cd myapp && go get github.com/carlosframework/rastrillo@latest && rastrillo dev
note: Visit localhost:8080 — that's your app. Edit an action, save, refresh: rastrillo dev regenerates, rebuilds, and restarts for you in about a second. A save that doesn't compile keeps the previous build serving while you fix it.
